method: Read retained full after-images and governing published Plan46; independently inverse every exact unified hunk to complete before Git blobs. Data-only Python/hash/JSON/text operations only; no application imports, hook/test execution, compiler, lint, browser, native, API or source mutation.

findings.reason: Exactly one nullable observation is recorded only after a real change/select finds no active valid trigger, for the same connected focused editable collapsed textarea. Pending contains original element/text/endpoints only, no catalog/provider authority. Deferred activation requires the same ref/element/connectivity/focus/editability/text/caret and original recognition/enable/validation gates; mismatch clears pending.

The enabled supported character set is deduplicated/sorted/serialized. The effect begins with scalar equality and returns before reading DOM or pending state on identity-only rerenders. A genuine transition may re-evaluate one original observation; without pending it performs no state update. A still unsupported/invalid trigger remains closed. activateTrigger clears pending before opening.

findings.area: Actual event text and stable activation
findings.reason: Change and select use event.currentTarget and its current value, eliminating render-captured stale selection text. Both use the same activation helper. Original text-change reset and same-query select navigation-index preservation remain. The helper does not add a timer, synthetic event, read loop, text/focus/caret write or provider request.

dismiss clears pending and original state. Non-IME closed-menu Escape clears pending before the existing open/count guard and does not newly consume the key. Textarea passes non-IME events to the already-guarded hook; its subsequent defaultPrevented return retains the old isOpen+nonempty scope. The existing above-popup Escape path and early IME return remain. Navigation/Enter/special composer/chip paths retain their owners.

The exact dynamic triggerChars expression remains, so unavailable slash does not steal @src/file recognition. Per-trigger enable and slash-leading validation stay intact. Existing readOnly suppression of input/key/select handlers is byte-exact. No task authority/submit/owner guard is widened.

The original13 parser cases and assertions are byte-exact after imports. Twenty expanded new cases mount the real hook with a real happy-dom textarea, while controlling prop commits and invoking actual hook event callbacks. They cover late supported character and enable predicate, stale select, dismiss/Escape, eight identity/editability mismatches, @ path grammar, three invalid strings, navigation/Enter and both IME signals. These are hook semantics, not proof of full React Composer event integration or native Chromium behavior.

Only two production dependencies append to the common supplementary source roster; the complete remainder/all exports/order invert exactly. Only one existing test operand appends to the fast-lint list (root117 to118); no command, parser, timeout, suite/config or existing operand is removed. Production textarea shrinks1431 to1429; hook421/test311 remain below800. No cap/baseline changes.

costAndLimits: Each render now derives the scalar enabled signature and calls the supplied enable predicate for supported unique characters; the actual caller predicates are pure length/boolean reads. Identity-only rerenders still incur this scalar work and an effect equality check, not a claim of zero overhead.
A genuine availability transition adds bounded DOM reads and, if admitted, existing caret-position mirror measurement plus React state updates. It adds no polling/timer/input action.
Focus qualification is current focus only; no blur listener proves uninterrupted focus. The published plan explicitly retains this limit.
Only changes in the enabled supported-character set trigger deferred re-evaluation, not arbitrary catalog-content or validation-predicate changes with an identical set; this is the selected contract.
IME change/select can still display suggestions under the old contract; no new composition state machine is claimed.
Tests directly invoke actual hook callbacks in happy-dom; real Composer/Chromium order, provider behavior and original Claude route require resulting-source CI.
All source/type/lint/test execution outcomes remain unclaimed. Source review is retrospective and does not manufacture prepublication review chronology.
